4. QC + subir 18 crops a Higgsfield (17 escenas + sabana_cultivos para c01)

base_prompt: Everything is visibly handmade from cut paper, cardboard and natural fibers: low relief, visible cut edges, real micro-shadows. Subtle stepped stop-motion cadence. No morphing, no melting, no photorealism, no 3D render look, no text.

clips.prompt: Handcrafted paper-maquette stop-motion animation. Dawn over the fertile paper savanna: thin mist drifts across the valley, young corn leaves in the foreground sway gently, the distant river glints, hut smoke rises. Slow gentle push-in. [BASE] No people appearing, no rain yet.

Handcrafted paper-maquette stop-motion animation. Macro on young paper corn cobs as the FIRST raindrops land one by one on the leaves, each drop settling visibly; the light dims from gold to grey; leaves tremble under each drop. One drop completes its fall. Very slow push-in. [BASE] No people.

Handcrafted paper-maquette stop-motion animation. Curtains of paper-thread rain drift across the valley left to right; the swollen grey river inches wider; hut smoke thins and dies. Slow lateral tracking left to right. [BASE] No people, no lightning.

Handcrafted paper-maquette stop-motion animation. From behind, the two still cut-paper figures under the eave watch grey water creep forward across the patio until it touches the three hearth stones; fine rain threads fall; their mantas hang heavy and still. The water completes its reach. Very slow push-in. [BASE] Figures do NOT move or talk, no faces.

Handcrafted paper-maquette stop-motion animation. Overhead view of the flooded paper savanna: the grey-blue water mirror shimmers softly, low mist crosses the frame, thatch roof islands hold still, drowned furrow lines waver under the surface. Slow overhead drift. [BASE] No people, no boats.

Handcrafted paper-maquette stop-motion animation. Rain circles expand one after another on the murky water over the drowned corn; a bent leaf drifts slowly past the sunken cob; grey light. One circle completes its ring. Slow push-in. [BASE] No people, no fish.

Handcrafted paper-maquette stop-motion animation. The file of cut-paper adults seen from behind climbs the green hill left to right through fine rain, woven bundles on shoulders swaying with each slow step; mist hides the flooded valley below. Slow lateral follow left to right. [BASE] Figures walk calmly, do NOT talk, no faces, no children.

Handcrafted paper-maquette stop-motion animation. Under the stretched cotton manta, the small paper flame strengthens and steadies between the sheltering hands; steam curls up; rain threads fall around the shelter edge. The flame completes its catch. Very slow push-in. [BASE] No faces, hands move minimally.

Handcrafted paper-maquette stop-motion animation, night scene. The paper hands gently place the folded woven textile beside the seeds on the flat stone before the offering fire; the warm glow pulses softly; thin smoke rises straight. The hands complete the offering and withdraw. Gentle push-in. [BASE] No faces.

Handcrafted paper-maquette stop-motion animation, night scene. The single warm fire point flickers on the dark hilltop silhouette, its thin smoke column rising into the rainy blue night; faint reflections tremble on the flooded valley below. Very slow push-in toward the fire. [BASE] No faces, figures stay tiny and still.

Handcrafted paper-maquette stop-motion animation. Golden light spreads as the rain curtains retreat; the faint desaturated paper rainbow over the distant closed rocks becomes slightly clearer; the dammed water glitters. Slow tilt up from the water to the rainbow. [BASE] No people, rainbow stays subtle.

Handcrafted paper-maquette stop-motion animation. Low-angle on the elder cut-paper figure standing on the rock: his grey hair and heavy manta move in the wind, he breathes calmly and tightens his grip on the golden-tipped staff against the golden storm sky. Reverent very slow push-in. [BASE] He does NOT talk, no flying, features stay exactly as the start frame.

Handcrafted paper-maquette stop-motion animation. The golden-tipped staff rises the final hand-width against the storm-gold sky, the hammered gold catching full light; suspended paper raindrops drift slowly around it. The raise completes and holds. Slow push-in. [BASE] No face, no lightning.

Handcrafted paper-maquette stop-motion animation. The golden staff FLIES flat and fast left to right over the dammed water leaving a thin gold paper trail; the two great rock walls CRACK with light lines between paper layers, first slabs shift apart, white paper spray leaps at the base. The staff completes its flight into the rock. Slow lateral tracking following the staff. [BASE] No people, no fire, no explosion smoke.

Handcrafted paper-maquette stop-motion animation. The newborn waterfall pours in tall paper layers between the opened rocks, cotton-fiber spray mist rising slowly from the void, wet rock walls glistening. Slow tilt up from the misty base to the crest. [BASE] No people, no rainbow.

Handcrafted paper-maquette stop-motion animation. Overhead view: the flood drains in bright channels toward the gap, green-ochre land patches widening around the thatch roofs, furrow lines re-emerging wet. Slow overhead drift toward the gap. [BASE] No people.

Handcrafted paper-maquette stop-motion animation. Ground-level macro: the paper hands press corn seeds into the dark wet furrow and gently cover them with soil; droplets still glint on the clods; warm morning light. The planting gesture completes. Gentle push-in. [BASE] No faces.

Handcrafted paper-maquette stop-motion animation. The reborn green savanna breathes: hut smoke rises thin and alive, the calm river glints toward the distant falls mist, corn leaves sway in the foreground, the faint paper rainbow holds steady in the washed sky. Very slow push-in settling into stillness. [BASE] No people or only tiny distant figures, rainbow stays subtle.
